groups.title: Finds real problems
groups.blurb: Popular projects nobody maintains anymore, each with something Tether should flag.

repos.about: Element UI for Vue 2 · 54k stars · last push April 2024
repos.finding: CI runs actions-cool/maintain-one-comment@v1.2.1, an Action whose repository GitHub has disabled, and pins it to a tag rather than a commit. A big repo: 73 targets in one scan.
repos.checked: GitHub shows “This repository has been disabled.” (3 Nov 2026). The owner account still exists, so nobody else can claim the name.

repos.about: Algorithmic trading library · 17.5k stars · last commit October 2020
repos.finding: A deleted S3 bucket in CI; details withheld until the maintainers are notified
repos.checked: NoSuchBucket in the team's live eval run (1 Nov 2026).

repos.about: Hexo blog theme · last commit May 2023
repos.finding: Loads Vue and MathJax from cdn.bootcss.com, a CDN tied to the operator behind the polyfill.io attack. Blogs that use these features run that script in every visitor's browser.
repos.checked: bootcss.com is on Tether's compromised-CDN list; the reference is in the code (2 Nov 2026).

repos.about: LBRY desktop app · 3.5k stars · LBRY shut down in 2023
repos.finding: The report page links to forum.lbry.tech, which no longer resolves. lbry.tech itself was about 70 days from expiring on 1 Nov 2026.
repos.checked: NXDOMAIN in the team's live eval run (1 Nov 2026).

groups.title: polyfill.io, still loading
groups.blurb: Smaller repos that still load the CDN that served malware to over 100,000 sites in 2024.

repos.about: Front-end starter kit · last commit May 2017
repos.finding: index.html loads https://cdn.polyfill.io/v2/polyfill.min.js with no integrity hash.
repos.checked: Critical in the team's eval run (1 Nov 2026); the reference is still there (2 Nov 2026).
